title: Four-generation Alvarez family
goal: A reader can trace four generations of the Alvarez family and distinguish the uneven sibling groups at each branch.

rubric.must: Manuel and Rosa appear at the top, their children appear on a second row, Miguel and Elena's children on a third row, and Nora and Leo on a fourth row.
Sofia, Miguel, and Teresa visibly descend together from the Manuel-Rosa partnership bar.
Lucia, Diego, Ines, and Tomas visibly descend together from the Miguel-Elena partnership bar.
Nora and Leo visibly descend together from the Diego-Carlos partnership bar.
Every descent line reaches its intended partnership bar without passing through a person symbol or another label.
Every displayed person has a readable name and birth year, with no overlapping labels.

ideal.notes: Four evenly spaced Alvarez generations show the three-, four-, and two-child sibships centred beneath their own parental couples, including Diego and Carlos. Names, birth years, and ages are individually readable.
